indicator.name: S&P 500 Forward P/E
indicator.description: The S&P 500 price divided by consensus next-twelve-month earnings.
indicator.methodology: S&P 500 price divided by FactSet's bottom-up consensus estimate of earnings for the next twelve months, as stated in FactSet's weekly Earnings Insight report. The value is read from the report text (one decimal place) and stored with the report date as both the observation and release date.
indicator.limitations: Weekly, rounded to one decimal, and parsed from a PDF, so a change in FactSet's wording can pause updates until the parser is fixed. History starts from the first report that was fetched, so percentile scores are weak until a backfill has been run. Check FactSet's terms of use before redistributing the series. Trailing P/E is never substituted and relabeled as forward P/E.
